# `profile` command

Profile a declared case and map the profile to the project's procedures and source lines.

```bash
fobis profile CASE [options]
```

How to use it, with examples: [Verifying results](/cookbook/verification), [HPC and clusters](/cookbook/hpc).

<!-- cli:begin -->
<!-- generated by docs/scripts/gen_cli_reference.py from the command line: do not edit -->

## All options

Arguments: `NAME`

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--fobos`, `-f` | TEXT |  | Specify a "fobos" file named differently from "fobos" |
| `--fci` |  |  | Assume fobos inputs as case insensitive |
| `--mode` | TEXT |  | Select a mode defined into a fobos file |
| `--tool` | TEXT | `gprof` | gprof (time, sampled; -pg build), callgrind (instructions per function and source line, inlined code included; much slower) or nsys (GPU kernel and host-device transfer times mapped to the directives, Nsight Systems). |
| `--top` | INTEGER | `15` | Routines, procedures and lines shown. |
| `--runner` | TEXT | `local` | Where the programs run: local, or slurm (jobs submitted with sbatch; [scheduler] settings). |
| `--json` |  |  | Emit structured JSON to stdout instead of human-readable output (useful for scripting / agents) |

<!-- cli:end -->
